summary: I played the berry race (4 whole W/A/D races from the menu), Jump in with its camera and the meadow at noon through FakeInteraction, and looked at the screenshots. Jump in's chase camera sits 9.5 m back and fails its suite test again in isolation. A first-play berry race is not reliably won, and a bench sitter is still shown as watching the sunset at 11:00. Five of the six host failures passed when run alone, so I count them as order-dependent.

failures.what: The jumped-in chase camera sits 9.5 m behind Sprout; the suite test 'While jumped in, the camera menu still counts' still fails when run alone
failures.steps: Menu: Jump in (WASD), Play, wait 2.5 s (tests/s53_play.jl 'Menu: choosing Jump in...', tests/dashboard.jl 'While jumped in, the camera menu still counts'). Measure the distance from game.rig.eye to Sprout.
failures.expected: The chase eye is under 8 m behind Sprout, as the dashboard test requires (it measured 7.96 m in an earlier run of mine).
failures.actual: 9.52 m, looking 0 m off Sprout in both tests. The camera is correct but about 1.5 m further back than it was, after the s53 camera or meadowlife changes. The screenshot looks fine.

failures.what: A first-play berry race (level 1, W/A/D only, always walking to the nearest free berry) is not reliably won
failures.steps: Menu: Berry race (WASD), Play, W, steer to the nearest berry with A/D. Four runs from the same start.
failures.expected: A first play is winnable, and the journal says the player won 8 to 6.
failures.actual: Results were 6 to 8 (the critters won), 8 to 6, 7 to 7 and 8 to 6. In every run one critter picks 4 berries. All 14 berries are gone after about 32 to 38 s of the 60 s, so the race is over early. I did not find out what the game does on a 7 to 7 tie. The new test 'Berry race from the menu...' fails whenever the player ends 2 or more behind.

failures.what: The 'On the island now' panel says 'Cumulus watches the sunset from the bench' at 11:00 in the morning
failures.steps: Jump the clock to 11:00 with skip_to_hour! (tests/s53_play.jl 'Meadow life by day') and read the right-hand panel; the 'Messages to you' panel next to it shows a stale message.
failures.expected: The bench sitter's status matches the time of day, for example 'sits on the bench'. A short wait after the jump is allowed.
failures.actual: The status still says sunset 2 s after the jump to 11:00. The screenshot shows Cumulus on the bench at noon. This may only be a lag in the panel after a clock jump, which a player would not cause.

tests_added: Menu: choosing Jump in (WASD) and pressing Play jumps in, with a chase camera that keeps Sprout in view
Berry race from the menu: start card, a whole W/A/D race ends with every berry taken, rivals score, and the player is not left far behind
Meadow life by day: stones, daisies, toadstools, stumps and logs are drawn in the meadow
